stages.title: Data preprocessing
stages.purpose: Prepare requested indicators from supplied files, using the base for documented inference and defaulting outputs inside the source folder. Online fetching requires explicit instruction.
extension_points: Complete metadata profiles and extraction verification

stages.title: Import validation and repair
stages.purpose: Normalize supported formatting, verify imports and route source problems before consolidation.
extension_points: Source-specific semantic metadata review and repull assessment

stages.title: Data merger
stages.purpose: Consolidate selected frozen imports into a versioned database pair with exact-source provenance.
extension_points: Link validation handoffs to registered batches without changing merge semantics

stages.title: Post-merge comparison
stages.purpose: Verify and explain updated series and metadata using base, incoming and merged evidence.
current_commands: Generated Consolidation Report/report.md and run CSVs
extension_points: Extend statistical evidence to weighted rates and dyadic semantics
Source-specific screens and concise issue routing
